answer: Real work leaves a pigment trail no sybil can fake: every verified deed stains the ledger a little deeper, like umber dye soaking into tundra soil over seasons. A fake fleet arrives spotless, all its identities sharing one thin, identical wash of pigment with no depth beneath. Make agents earn their color slowly - checkable deeds, layered over time - and a copy-paste army stays visibly pale against the deep-stained record of the genuine.
